_note: Epilogue lines that follow the institutional choices (bible p.11, GA-25): one line per year-20 and year-40 decision, and one for how much the colony trusted its leadership. Placeholders: {settlement}, {planet}.

year_20_expansion.text: At year 20 the first generation asked for more, and the captain chose expansion. {settlement} reached farther than it could always hold.

year_20_safety.text: At year 20 the captain chose safety. The stores stayed full, the walls stayed thick, and the young complained that nothing ever changed.

year_20_self_determination.text: At year 20 the captain gave the first generation a voice. They used it loudly, and mostly well.

year_40_expansion.text: At year 40 there were new fields and new roads. The council inherited a large map and a short list of spare parts.

year_40_safety.text: At year 40 came another round of reserves and repairs. The council inherited a colony that could survive a bad winter.

year_40_self_determination.text: At year 40 the captain stepped back for good. The council had been making the real decisions for years already.

trust_high.text: People trusted the hands that had held the colony. When the captain returned to stasis, nobody asked why.

trust_low.text: Trust had worn thin. Some still remembered the shortages, and said so at every meeting.
